fixtureSources.bench-reuse-stdin-register.js: process.stdin.on('data', () => console.log('leaked stdin')); process.stdin.pause(); console.log('stdin paused');
fixtureSources.bench-reuse-wait.js: (async () => { await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 150)); console.log('timer clean'); })();

concurrency.poolCap: This browser check verifies the retained follow-up idle Worker; RuntimeWorkerPool tests cover the idle cap.

metricSemantics.acquisitionMs: Time from pool acquisition request until the acquired Worker is confirmed ready.
metricSemantics.preparedWorker: True when execution borrowed a prewarmed idle slot.
metricSemantics.workerStartMs: Time from immediately before start-message send until Worker start-handler entry; excludes prewarm/construct time and is not comparable to the earlier construct-to-handler metric.
metricSemantics.clockResolution: Small negative workerStartMs values are preserved and can occur below clock resolution.
